raw_response: {"diagnosis": "On 2026-01-16 the card feed renamed status 'POSTED' to 'SETTLED' with the meaning unchanged. The silver filter `status = 'POSTED'` therefore drops every batch 12-14 row, which carries only SETTLED and REVERSED, while REVERSED rows should remain excluded. Treating SETTLED as POSTED restores batches 12-14 without changing the rest of the logic.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
